# Aladin Lite 3.9.2-beta

This is the unmodified browser distribution from the [upstream npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/aladin-lite/-/aladin-lite-3.9.2-beta.tgz). Aladin Lite is developed at the Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg by Thomas Boch, Matthieu Baumann, and the upstream contributors. The library is licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later. The included `LICENSE` and `COPYING` contain the full licence texts.

[Complete corresponding source for this build](https://codeload.github.com/cds-astro/aladin-lite/tar.gz/9f4d8b3679fb433b3ffb01927fdc8abd2fb00f02) · [Upstream build instructions and credits](https://github.com/cds-astro/aladin-lite/tree/v3.9.2-beta)

`aladin.js` SHA-256: `575eff7e672bc99a1a5bf62469b75455353aa6574a75bcfbfc2c53c799f6693f`.

SKYSHIFT loads this independent JavaScript module by URL, preserving the library's logo and site link. The optional background uses the [MAST mirror of DSS Color](https://stpubdata.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/mast/skybackgrounds/DSSColor/properties), a Digitized Sky Survey product from STScI and NASA, coloured and tiled by CDS.
